$comment: Three recurring beliefs. Every post reinforces one, or makes a clearly labelled challenge to one. Edit these; the agent reads this file at request time.

beliefs.claim: Reliable AI automation is an orchestration problem, not merely a model-selection problem.
beliefs.opposingBelief: Pick the best model and the workflow will be reliable.
evidenceAngles: routing rules that decide which step runs at all
retry semantics that do not duplicate side effects
the cost difference between a good prompt and a good queue

beliefs.claim: Businesses should automate expensive failure points before automating impressive demos.
beliefs.opposingBelief: Start with the flashiest use case so the team gets excited.
evidenceAngles: lead response time measured in hours
manual re-keying between two systems of record
work that gets redone because the first pass was wrong

beliefs.claim: A good agent is observable, recoverable, and tied to a measurable business outcome.
beliefs.opposingBelief: If the output looks right in testing, the automation is done.
evidenceAngles: a run log a non-engineer can read
a defined recovery path for every failure mode
one business metric the workflow is accountable for
alerting that fires before the customer notices
